thread:
olivia_cs: Harbor onboarding blocked on our mobile warmup step. Their emulator farm runs 120 parallel preflights; seeing ~22% 429s and sporadic 401s. Can SDK/eng help triage?

harbor_team: Repro: each emulator creates an ephemeral session then immediately calls /v1/preflight. No shared token cache. Sample responses: "HTTP/1.1 429 Too Many Requests
Retry-After: 1
X-Request-Id: hb-22c" and "HTTP/1.1 401 Unauthorized
X-Request-Id: hb-22f"

sam_sdk: Which SDK and version? Any custom proxy in front of the emulator farm?

harbor_team: mobile-js-sdk@0.17.2, they route through an internal test-proxy which preserves Origin. No token reuse across emulators.

ben_eng: Likely token creation + immediate preflight causing origin burst. Quick fixes: 1) tiny in-process lease so concurrent emulators reuse a token for ~2-3s; 2) stagger startup with small random delay; 3) if using a proxy, ensure it reuses connections (keep-alive).

sam_sdk: Small snippet we advise: ```js
// simple lease for emulator process
let L=null;
async function getToken(){ if(L && Date.now()<L.exp) return L.t; const r=await fetch('/session/create'); const t=await r.text(); L={t,exp:Date.now()+2500}; return t; }
```

olivia_cs: I'll ask RevOps for a temporary onboarding quota increase. Any other quick checks?

harbor_team: We saw one 401 when our CI VM clock drifted ~10s. We synced NTP and it disappeared.

ben_eng: Good catch. Add clock sync to onboarding checklist. Also, if the proxy mutates auth headers or strips Origin sometimes, that can surface as 401s — please verify proxy logs for dropped headers.

sam_sdk: If they want a long-term SDK change, we can add an "ephemeralLease" mode that coalesces session calls per origin for a short window. We'll draft a PR.

deploy-bot: NOTICE: rate-limit rule preflight-origin-3s applied to preflight-service at 2026-03-18T04:12Z.

harbor_team: After adding 2.5s lease + 0-200ms jitter we reran 120 emulators: 429s dropped to ~4%, no 401s. Looks good.

olivia_cs: Excellent. I'll keep the quota request open until they finish full warmup. Drafting a tiny runbook for Harbor with lease snippet and NTP check.

sam_sdk: Filed SDK follow-up to add example config.

ben_eng: Engineering follow-up: consider short buffering (200-400ms) at preflight ingress to smooth mass warmups.

harbor_team: Will run overnight smoke and confirm in morning. Thanks all!
